description:
Responsibilities: 
 As the Software Engineer, Manufacturing, you will lead and manage a team which will create, execute, and administrate applications within the Manufacturing Engineering department. Goal is to digitally transform operations by eliminating the use of paper on the manufacturing floor while maintaining data integrity and product traceability. 
  
 Administer and lead deployment of Manufacturing Execution System (MES) by Q4 2026 

 Harvest process and manufacturing data for reporting such as yield, cycle times, productivity by Q4 2026. 

 Lead design and deployment of data warehousing and dashboards 

 Create a controlled environment for applications development and release from proto phase through manufacturing phase (Software Lifecycle Management) within 6 months of joining team. 

 Lead creation of workflows and/or programs in manufacturing to automate solutions such as automatic label printing. 

 Configure and develop solutions using Databases (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.) and programming skills (such as C#, .NET, JavaScript, JSON) 

 Lead change management, train end-users, and ensure ongoing system reliability 
 Ensure MES solutions comply with GMP, MIL and ISO9001/AS9100 standards. 
 Lead and develop a team of data analysts 
 Conduct regular system audits and upgrades as necessary 

 Integrate ERP, PLM, Payroll systems with MES system 

 Lead and implement automated data integration with MES system 

 Create mfg. software controlled repository 

  
  
 Qualifications – External/internal: 
 Strong understanding of APIs, system integration, and cloud platforms (AWS, GovCloud, Azure, GCP) 
 SQL fluency is a must. Hands-on experience with using SQL to pull data for complex analytics 
 2+ years’ experience in the manufacturing software development/sustainment environment. 
 Good working knowledge of MS Office applications: Word, Excel, Power, Access, Visio, and Project 
 Hands-on experience with Azure or similar data bases 
 Interpersonal skills promoting effective interaction with other staff, customers, and suppliers. 
 Knowledge of Quality Management Systems and practices a must.  
 2+ years' experience with Aegis and/or Oracle MES systems a plus 
 Experience with Kaizen and continuous improvement tools a plus 
  
  
 Education and Experience: 
 B.S. Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, and/or Math
